(1) and its largest-DU floor, Tables 4, 6, 11, 12, Annex B full pipe at h/d 0.5) and AAV air flow (EN 12056-2 §6.5.3 stack 8·Qtot: Durgo worked example; §6.4.3 Table 10 branch 1·Qtot systems I/IV, 2·Qtot systems II/III: hand cases); 5 invalid-input cases (METHOD §1 input rules: unknown or inherited fixture key, negative length/drop/bends/gradient, fractional bends) must be rejected with exactly the expected error codes

EN 12380:2002 Air admittance valves for drainage systems

Secondary for AAVs: stack worked example (8·Qtot) and the open-vent rule: Durgo, Dimensioning in accordance with EN 12056 (https://inspectapedia.com/plumbing/Durgo-Air-Admittance-Valve-Instructions.pdf); McAlpine AAV brochure (https://www.mytub.co.uk/product_images/McAlpine_AirAdmittanceValve_Brochure.pdf)
tolerance: exact on every chosen DN, pipe outer diameter, vent DN and on the set of rule flags; ΣDU exact; relative 0.5 % on flows, drain capacity, velocity and AAV air flow; ±0.002 on the filling degree h/d; the headline tiles must show ΣDU (±0.05) and Qtot (±0.005 l/s)

provenance_note: The Table 4/5/7/8 values and footnote readings used by both the engine and the ref were checked against the licensed EN 12056-2:2000 text by an independent reviewer (bw-r1), not by the ref itself. Expected ΣDU, Qww/Qtot, the chosen DN of every branch, stack and drain, the drain capacity at the filling limit, filling degree h/d and velocity, vent DN, AAV air flow of stacks and branches and the set of rule flags were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_plbdrainage.py, an independent Python implementation written from the published method (_plb/drain/METHOD.md: Qww = K·√ΣDU floored at the largest DU, EN 12056-2 Tables 1, 4–7, 11, 12, Prandtl–Colebrook for partly filled drains with the hydraulic diameter solved by scipy brentq; AAV air flow per EN 12056-2 §6.4.3 Table 10 and §6.5.3), not from the page code. Discharge units (EN 12056-2 Table 2) and pipe series are input data from the published method.
